lines.t: Thus says the Lord, say no more
Grace versus the Lord
Say rather grace and the Lord
For grace is the fulfillment of the law
And where there is an absence of grace
There is lawlessness
Therefore keeping the law
Is a reflection of my own spirit in you
For anyone who says
I am in the Lord and he is in me
While forsaking the law is a lie
And will be found as such in the day of reckoning
For I am who I am
The same and unchanging
Nor do I stand divide against myself
Yet my children do continually use my name
And that gift given them as a sword
By which they attempt to justify their sins
Which I hate
Desecration
Thus until the day be fulfilled
Let those who do wickedly continue therein
And let those who seek righteousness walk therein
Until the harvest is complete
But oh, how blessed are those who have received of grace
And seek to please the Father by obeying His law and teach men so.
Grace and the Lord.
Grace and the Lord.
Grace and the Lord
